def pow2 : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 1
  | l + 1 => 2 * pow2 l

def mpow (b : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, m => 1 % m
  | e + 1, m => (mpow b e m * (b % m)) % m
